name: Burly Men at Sea
source: Three burly fishermen (Hasty Beard, Steady Beard, and Brave Beard) find an empty-looking map in their net and decide to investigate further. A combination visual novel and point-and-click adventure.
translation: 三名身材魁梧的渔民（急速胡子、稳重胡子和勇敢胡子）在网中发现了一张看上去空无一物的地图，并决定进一步调查。视觉小说和点击式冒险的结合。
